recommendation: Keep the no-change audit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-7874 unless a future Patient Administration tracker changes the HL7 v2 mapping itself.
issue_request: FHIR-7874 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Administration correction from the DSTU1 ballot asking to add an HL7 v2 mapping from Patient.careProvider to PD1-4, Primary Care Provider.
initial_application: Git commit 2ca6343b43 explicitly applied the tracker by adding PD1-4 to Patient.careProvider in source/patient/patient-spreadsheet.xml; later source migrations carried the mapping into source/patient/structuredefinition-Patient.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-7963 later renamed Patient.careProvider to Patient.generalPractitioner while retaining careProvider as an alias and preserving the PD1-4 mapping. That related rename issue is already represented on the combined branch by its own audit commit. Patient is active in source/fhir.ini, and community searches found no later conflicting mapping decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current authoritative Patient StructureDefinition already has alias careProvider and v2 map PD1-4 on Patient.generalPractitioner.

related_jiras.note: Renamed Patient.careProvider to Patient.generalPractitioner while retaining careProvider as an alias; already audited separately on the combined branch.
